name: Clay-tolerant superplasticizer
problem: Clay in low-carbon cement and dirty sand soaks up superplasticizer, so concrete stiffens
design: Clay-tolerant superplasticizer that keeps concrete flowing

market.what: PCE superplasticizers incl. clay-tolerant grades and sacrificial agents, world; China ~half; part of $21-23B concrete admixtures
market.method: reports $6.6-7.9B (2025); bottom-up: China ~16 Mt (20% soln) x ¥1,765/t = $3.9B (Sobute 1.05 Mt at ~6.5% share) + rest of world 2.1 Gt cement x ~0.08% PCE solids x ~$2.5/kg = $4.2B (est.) = ~$8B

value.logic: less overdose: ~1/3 of $7.5B PCE goes into clay-hit mixes (China >80% manufactured sand, India, LC3) at ~40% extra dose = ~$0.7B; halve it = $0.35B. More clay: ~70 LC3 plants x ~1 Mt x 5 pts less clinker = 3.5 Mt clinker x (0.85 t CO2 x $85 + ~$15) = $0.3B (est.)
value.revenue_logic: license to a mid-tier PCE maker (China/India) 3% x ~$200M sales = $6M + own sacrificial agent ~2 kt/yr x $3/kg = $6M (est.)
value.margin_logic: royalty ~90%; agent sold into price-war PCE market ~35-40%; Sika material margin 54.9% (2025)

trend.drivers: LC3/calcined clay scale-up (~35 plants running, ~35 building; Holcim 0.5 Mt in H1 2025); EU ETS ~€75-85/t; manufactured sand in China/India; China volumes falling
trend.deadline: EU CBAM definitive phase and free-allocation cut start 1 Jan 2026

competition.notes: Sika strongest: CHF 11.2B sales 2025, has ViscoCrete calcined-clay line; Saint-Gobain sells CLARENA clay-mitigation range, bought Fosroc $1.025B (2025); China fragmented (CR3 ~15%); no funded startup found on a new clay-tolerant PCE molecule; Concretene (graphene admixture) £3M; Alcemy $10M

lab.synth: polymer: PCE comb copolymer by aqueous radical polymerization (HPEG/TPEG macromonomer + acrylic acid + design comonomer), 1-2 step, cheap monomers; or 1-2 step cationic sacrificial agent; 3 variants
lab.test: mini-slump / flow table (ASTM C1437, EN 1015-3) and Marsh cone on paste/mortar with 1-3% montmorillonite sand and LC3 binder; PCE adsorption on clay by TOC; ASTM C109 / EN 196-1 mortar strength 1-28 d; university concrete lab
lab.logic: synth 6-8 wk + tests 6 wk (28-d cubes); synth ~$20k (polymer CRO, low end) + lab time ~$10k + ~90 cubes x $30 + TOC ~40 x $50 (est.)

sale.gates: EN 934-2 CE marking (type tests + notified-body FPC audit) or ASTM C494 (strength to 6 mo/1 yr); ready-mix/precast plant trials 3-6 mo; admixture-maker license deal
